reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Every Layout (https://every-layout.dev/).
Technology stack: css, web-components.
Component specification: 最后开 The Stack：问题、解法、生成器和组件分节都在。

Visual details from source observation: 我们进首页，封面旁边就是购买按钮和免费 rudiments 链接。Boxes 页把盒模型图画出来，左侧列出 Stack、Box、Center。我们打开 The Stack：问题、解决方案、生成器和自定义元素分节写。适合要少写断点、用原语拼布局的人。入门免费；完整布局、生成器和书要付费。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
